description: Experience the rich cultural tapestry of Japan with this 10-day itinerary, exploring ancient traditions in Kyoto, vibrant city life in Osaka, the natural beauty of Sapporo, and the bustling metropolis of Tokyo. This trip focuses on cultural activities, historical sites, and local experiences.

accommodation.amenities: parking, kids club, bar, rooftop terrace, beach access, breakfast included

restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival in Kyoto & Cultural Immersion
days.description: Arrive in Kyoto and settle into your hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring the city's cultural offerings.

activities.notes:
What you'll see: Explore various museums and galleries showcasing Kyoto's rich artistic and historical heritage.
What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a camera.
What to eat: Try local Kyoto specialties like Yuba (tofu skin) or Matcha sweets.
Good to know: Check the opening hours of specific museums in advance.

days.title: Historic Kyoto Walking Tour
days.description: Discover the ancient streets and hidden gems of Kyoto on a guided walking tour.

activities.activity_name: Historic Kyoto City Walking Tour — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Historic temples, traditional wooden houses, and beautiful gardens in Kyoto's Gion district.
What to bring: Comfortable shoes, water, and a camera.
What to eat: Sample traditional Japanese snacks from local vendors.
Good to know: Be respectful of local customs and traditions, especially in sacred areas.

days.title: Kyoto Countryside Exploration
days.description: Embark on a day trip to experience the serene beauty of the Kyoto countryside.

activities.notes:
What you'll see: Picturesque rural landscapes, traditional villages, and possibly a visit to a local farm or craft workshop.
What to bring: Comfortable clothing, sturdy shoes, and a camera.
What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese lunch at a local eatery.
Good to know: This is a full-day excursion, so plan accordingly.

days.title: Travel to Osaka & City Photography
days.description: Travel to Osaka and capture its unique urban charm through a photography tour.

activities.activity_name: Osaka Old Town Photography Tour — Premium Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Iconic landmarks and hidden alleys of Osaka's old town, perfect for photography.
What to bring: Your camera, extra batteries, and comfortable walking shoes.
What to eat: Try local street food like Takoyaki or Okonomiyaki.
Good to know: A guide will provide tips on composition and lighting.

days.title: Osaka Museums & Culture
days.description: Immerse yourself in Osaka's cultural institutions with a museum and gallery pass.

activities.notes:
What you'll see: A selection of Osaka's finest museums and art galleries.
What to bring: Comfortable shoes and an open mind for art and history.
What to eat: Enjoy a casual lunch at a museum cafe.
Good to know: Plan your visits to maximize your time and interests.

days.title: Travel to Sapporo & Historic Walking Tour
days.description: Travel to Sapporo and explore its historic city center on a morning walking tour.

activities.activity_name: Historic Sapporo City Walking Tour — Morning Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Key historical sites and architectural landmarks in Sapporo's city center.
What to bring: Warm clothing if traveling in winter, comfortable walking shoes, and a camera.
What to eat: Grab a warm drink and a local pastry from a cafe.
Good to know: This tour provides a great overview of Sapporo's history and development.

days.title: Sapporo Museum & Gallery Exploration
days.description: Delve deeper into Sapporo's cultural scene with a premium museum and gallery pass.

activities.activity_name: Sapporo Museum & Gallery Pass — Premium Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Access to a wider range of museums and galleries, offering in-depth cultural experiences.
What to bring: Your pass, comfortable shoes, and an interest in local art and history.
What to eat: Enjoy a meal at one of the museum's dining options or a nearby restaurant.
Good to know: This premium pass offers extended access and potentially exclusive exhibits.

days.title: Travel to Tokyo & Historic Walking Tour
days.description: Travel to Tokyo and begin your exploration of the capital with a historic walking tour.

activities.notes:
What you'll see: Historic landmarks and traditional neighborhoods in Tokyo, such as Asakusa.
What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes, water, and a camera.
What to eat: Sample traditional Japanese street food in Asakusa.
Good to know: This tour offers a glimpse into Tokyo's past amidst its modern facade.

days.title: Tokyo Museums & Photography
days.description: Spend the day exploring Tokyo's museums and capturing its unique urban landscape.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Museum & Gallery Pass — Morning Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: A curated selection of Tokyo's museums and galleries, focusing on art and history.
What to bring: Your pass, comfortable shoes, and an appreciation for Japanese culture.
What to eat: Enjoy a light lunch at a museum cafe or a nearby restaurant.
Good to know: This pass allows for flexible exploration of multiple cultural venues.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Old Town Photography Tour — Small Group Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Picturesque old town areas of Tokyo, ideal for capturing traditional Japanese aesthetics.
What to bring: Your camera, extra memory cards, and comfortable walking shoes.
What to eat: Discover local snacks and treats during your photography adventure.
Good to know: This small group tour offers personalized guidance for better photo opportunities.

days.title: Departure from Tokyo
days.description: Enjoy a final Japanese breakfast before heading to Narita Airport for your return flight to Sydney.
